note.title: Photosynthesis and uses of glucose
note.overview: Photosynthesis transfers light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose; plants use glucose in several ways.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for photosynthesis and uses of glucose.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Carbon dioxide + water -> glucose + oxygen; light and chlorophyll are required.
Glucose is used in respiration and to make starch, cellulose, lipids, proteins and other sugars.
Nitrate-derived nitrogen is needed to make amino acids and proteins.
